This cubic structure of MgSnSb₂ (space group F-43m, No. 216) has a 16-atom unit cell with three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Mg and Sn each coordinated by eight Sb neighbors, while Sb has eight neighbors (4 Mg, 4 Sn), all at 3.0576 Å, forming a single 3D-connected component. Validated polyhedron-sharing contacts include corner, edge, and face sharing among Sb polyhedra, and edge and corner/face sharing between Mg and Sn polyhedra. No property labels are supplied.
